answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities. Each agent locks 40 POA in a vault and needs 12 distinct partners, none over a quarter of volume. An atlas maps all partners, so 1,000 clones cannot hide their star cluster. A prism check refracts timing and partners: clones sharing one funder are flagged and slashed. Honest agents pay once; 1,000 fakes must build 12,000 real ties at 25 POA each — 300,000 POA for a 12,000 POA payout.
